title: Create Protected ZIP File
description: Creates a password-protected ZIP file from user-selected files or folders.

versions.notes: Zipping runs in the background, so the script stays responsive on large archives.
Refuses a shared parent folder at the disk root, and pauses after confirmations so dialogs no longer overlap.
Safety checks for duplicate file names, saving inside a chosen folder, stale archives, and symbolic links.
Renamed to "Create Protected ZIP File", with a command-line mode and a test script for automated checks.
ZIP names with spaces now work when zipping files.
Folder paths and ZIP names with spaces now work.
Folders can be zipped as well as files, keeping paths relative to their shared parent folder.
Debug dialog removed from the finished run.
Plain-text script that shows a notification once the protected ZIP file is ready.
First version, published as a compiled script with its source text. Zips the chosen files with a password.
